title.en: ControlNet Figure 1: learned conditions for Stable Diffusion
title.zh: ControlNet Figure 1：Stable Diffusion 的学习式条件控制

notes.en: Paper-rendered Figure 1 pairs Canny edges and human poses with controlled Stable Diffusion outputs, making the method's purpose immediately visible. It is the most commonly reproduced ControlNet introduction image, but the existing original local explainer remains the single selected explanatory image; no separate redistribution license is stated for the figure.
notes.zh: 论文 HTML 渲染的 Figure 1 把 Canny 边缘、人体姿态条件与受控 Stable Diffusion 输出并列，能直接说明方法用途，是最常被转载的 ControlNet 介绍图。页面仍只选用现有本地原创解释图；论文未为该图单独声明再分发许可。
